cases.input: Actual gate on isolated bridge with failing unittest

regressions.method: Execute real manifest gate on minimal isolated Python fixture; unrelated parent gates use explicitly synthetic test logs.

environment.note: Isolated Linux coverage target avoids pre-existing Windows build artifacts in the shared default target; all gates execute unchanged.

limitations: This repair qualifies the parent Python bridge gate and its failure propagation; it does not complete host integration or live model qualification.
No issue state, publication, commit or model promotion is changed.
